descriptions.preferred: The vigorous long new shoots or "tentacles" of this attractive red dissectum arch outward and downward to give it the name 'Octopus'. The new leaves are pink red with a narrow greenish band down the middle of each lobe, becoming a darker plum red, then a coppery red with a greenish tinge along the midrib as the leaf develops in early summer. The color turns to a bright crimson-red in the fall. The deeply dissected medium-sized leaves vary from 7 to 8 cm long and from 8 to 11 cm broad. The lobes are 1-2 cm wide and are themselves deeply dissected and conspicuously toothed. The teeth have many sharppointed tips. The slender orange-red petioles are 1.5-3 cm long. Like most dissectums, this strong-growing plant grows into a broad dome with pendulous shoots and foliage, reaching about 2-5 m high and 3-3.5 m wide as it matures. However, because of the uneven growth of the current shoots, varying between 1 and almost 2 m long, the outer circumference is more irregular.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一迷人的红色 Dissectum 品种，其强健而细长的新梢或“触手”向外并向下拱垂，因此得名 'Octopus'。新叶呈粉红红色，每个裂片中央有一条狭窄的绿色带，随后转为更深的李子红；到初夏叶片发育过程中，又变为带铜色的红色，且中脉附近略带绿色。秋季叶色转为鲜亮的深红色。深裂的中等大小叶片长 7-8 厘米，宽 8-11 厘米。裂片宽 1-2 厘米，自身又进一步深裂，并具明显锯齿；锯齿先端多而尖锐。细长的橙红色叶柄长 1.5-3 厘米。与大多数 Dissectum 品种一样，该品种生长势较强，成熟后形成宽阔的圆拱形树冠，枝叶下垂，高约 2-5 米，宽约 3-3.5 米。不过，由于当年生枝条生长不均，长度从 1 米到近 2 米不等，外缘轮廓会显得较不规则。
